responsibility: Provides the inference-context-aware debug formatting infrastructure for `rustc_type_ir`. It defines the `DebugWithInfcx` protocol and the `WithInfcx` wrapper used to format type IR values while optionally consulting an `InferCtxtLike` for richer rendering of inference variables and universes, along with a `NoInfcx` fallback for plain debugging when no inference context is available.
